mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.instrument_id, f.period_end, f.report_type, f.published_at, f.version, f.revenue, f.net_profit, f.operating_cashflow, f.gross_margin, f.revenue_yoy, f.profit_yoy, f.source, f.created_at, f.updated_at, f.available_at, f.publication_precision, f.vendor_updated_at, f.fetched_at, f.content_hash, f.source_url, f.raw_json FROM financial_report f JOIN instrument i ON i.id=f.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol=#{symbol} AND f.published_at <= #{cutoff} AND COALESCE(f.available_at, f.published_at)<=#{cutoff} ORDER BY period_end DESC, version DESC LIMIT 100
